Synthetic JPEG ICC regression corpus supplied for the 1.0.3 repair. No personal
media is included. `cases.json` binds every input to its SHA-256 and expected path.

The 240 x 160 RGB patch raster has EXIF orientation 6 and synthetic private text.
The independent 160 x 240 PNG references were generated by Pillow/LittleCMS 2:
`srgb.png` preserves the encoded values and `wide.png` applies the source wide
profile to sRGB with relative colorimetric intent. Tests compare eight interior
patches; an sRGB assumption for a valid wide profile fails that comparison.

The wide profile uses D65, gamma 2.2 and primaries (0.68,0.32), (0.265,0.69),
(0.15,0.06). The split fixture physically reverses two numbered ICC APP2 segments.
The padded fixture appends exactly three zero bytes beyond its valid declaration.
Four RGB fixtures independently damage the ICC signature, tag count or declared
length. Negative controls truncate a pixel scan or contain uncharacterized CMYK.

These prebuilt development fixtures and references require no Python, Pillow or
LittleCMS installation to run the application or the PowerShell acceptance tests.
